about: Set Aside (Remainder, 2026). Silent rises of the lowest condition code in Alabama's National Bridge Inventory files 1993-2025, from projects/the-lowest-code/session2-rises.json.gz and session1-per.json.gz. Stroke = [bridge, y0, y1, code before, code after, h=held|f=fell back|o=other]. Line = lowest code per file year 1993-2025, '-' where the structure number is absent, 'N' where no item is rated.
